WITH
  "scan_from" AS (
    SELECT "i"."customer_id" AS "customer_id"
    FROM "sales"."public"."fact_invoice" AS "i"
  ),
  "scan_to" AS (
    SELECT "c"."customer_id" AS "customer_id"
    FROM "sales"."public"."dim_customer" AS "c"
  ),
  "orphans" AS (
    SELECT "f"."customer_id"
    FROM "scan_from" AS "f"
    WHERE "f"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "scan_to" AS "t"
        WHERE "t"."customer_id" = "f"."customer_id"
      )
  )
SELECT "customer_id"
FROM "orphans"

WITH
  "bounds" AS (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN length(CAST($1 AS VARCHAR)) = 4 THEN make_date(CAST(CAST($1 AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER), 1, 1)
      WHEN substr(CAST($1 AS VARCHAR), 6, 1) = 'Q' THEN make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($1 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(substr(CAST($1 AS VARCHAR), 7, 1) AS INTEGER) * 3 - 2, 1)
      WHEN substr(CAST($1 AS VARCHAR), 6, 1) = 'W' THEN CAST(date_trunc('week', make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($1 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), 1, 4)) AS DATE) + 7 * (CAST(substr(CAST($1 AS VARCHAR), 7, 2) AS INTEGER) - 1)
      WHEN length(CAST($1 AS VARCHAR)) = 7 THEN make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($1 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(substr(CAST($1 AS VARCHAR), 6, 2) AS INTEGER), 1)
      ELSE CAST(CAST($1 AS VARCHAR) AS DATE)
    END AS "from_day",
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN length(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR)) = 4 THEN make_date(CAST(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER), 1, 1)
      WHEN substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 6, 1) = 'Q' THEN make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 7, 1) AS INTEGER) * 3 - 2, 1)
      WHEN substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 6, 1) = 'W' THEN CAST(date_trunc('week', make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), 1, 4)) AS DATE) + 7 * (CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 7, 2) AS INTEGER) - 1)
      WHEN length(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR)) = 7 THEN make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 6, 2) AS INTEGER), 1)
      ELSE CAST(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR) AS DATE)
    END + CASE
      WHEN length(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR)) = 4 THEN INTERVAL 1 YEAR
      WHEN substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 6, 1) = 'Q' THEN INTERVAL 3 MONTH
      WHEN substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 6, 1) = 'W' THEN INTERVAL 7 DAY
      WHEN length(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR)) = 7 THEN INTERVAL 1 MONTH
      ELSE INTERVAL 1 DAY
    END - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATE) AS "to_day"
  ),
  "scan_base" AS (
    SELECT "i"."invoice_date" AS "invoice_date", "i"."customer_id" AS "customer_id", "i"."amount" AS "amount"
    FROM "sales"."public"."fact_invoice" AS "i"
    CROSS JOIN "bounds" AS "b"
    WHERE "i"."invoice_date" >= "b"."from_day"
      AND "i"."invoice_date" <= "b"."to_day"
  ),
  "aggregate_base" AS (
    SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', "invoice_date") AS DATE) AS "month", "customer_id" AS "customer_id",
      SUM("amount") AS "amount_sum", COUNT("amount") AS "amount_count"
    FROM "scan_base"
    GROUP BY ALL
  ),
  "scan_summary" AS (
    SELECT "s"."month" AS "month", "s"."customer_id" AS "customer_id", "s"."amount_sum" AS "amount_sum", "s"."amount_count" AS "amount_count"
    FROM "sales"."public"."agg_invoice_month" AS "s"
    CROSS JOIN "bounds" AS "b"
    WHERE "s"."month" >= "b"."from_day"
      AND "s"."month" <= "b"."to_day"
  ),
  "compared" AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE("a"."month", "s"."month") AS "month",
      COALESCE("a"."customer_id", "s"."customer_id") AS "customer_id",
      "a"."amount_sum" AS "base.amount_sum", "s"."amount_sum" AS "summary.amount_sum",
      "a"."amount_count" AS "base.amount_count", "s"."amount_count" AS "summary.amount_count",
      CASE
        WHEN "s"."month" IS NULL THEN 'missing_in_summary'
        WHEN "a"."month" IS NULL THEN 'missing_in_base'
        WHEN "a"."amount_sum" IS DISTINCT FROM "s"."amount_sum"
          OR "a"."amount_count" IS DISTINCT FROM "s"."amount_count" THEN 'measure_differs'
      END AS "violation"
    FROM "aggregate_base" AS "a"
    FULL OUTER JOIN "scan_summary" AS "s"
      ON "a"."month" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "s"."month"
      AND "a"."customer_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "s"."customer_id"
  )
SELECT "month", "customer_id", "base.amount_sum", "summary.amount_sum", "base.amount_count", "summary.amount_count", "violation"
FROM "compared"
WHERE "violation" IS NOT NULL
